proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C
  set d : V := C -ᵥ B with hd
  set h : V := A -ᵥ midpoint ℝ B C with hh
  have e1 : A -ᵥ B = h + (1 / 2 : ℝ) • d := by
    rw [hh, hd, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel A (midpoint ℝ B C) B, midpoint_vsub_left, invOf_eq_inv, one_div]
  have e2 : A -ᵥ C = h - (1 / 2 : ℝ) • d := by
    rw [hh, hd, ← vsub_add_vsub_cancel A (midpoint ℝ B C) C, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev C,
      right_vsub_midpoint, invOf_eq_inv, one_div]
  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ dist_nonneg dist_nonneg, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A B, dist_eq_norm_vsub V A C, e1, e2,
    norm_add_sq_real, norm_sub_sq_real, real_inner_smul_right]
  constructor <;> intro hx <;> linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), dist A B = dist A C ↔ inner ℝ (A -ᵥ midpoint ℝ B C) (C -ᵥ B) = 0
